# Upstream reference snapshots

**Reference only; not runtime engine.** These files preserve a small selection of complete, unmodified source files from public dependency repositories for source review. Do not import, execute, install, or dispatch these files from the RICE-PO engine. They are not RICE-PO author code and do not imply author endorsement.

| Directory | Upstream | Frozen commit | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `diver/` | [AQ-MedAI/Diver](https://github.com/AQ-MedAI/Diver) | `cfdf09ad863540f78a655880ef133c4cb28b3676` | [Apache-2.0](diver/LICENSE.txt) |
| `reasonir/` | [facebookresearch/ReasonIR](https://github.com/facebookresearch/ReasonIR) | `0aac96269e455965949df16520fab72da68ffc22` | [CC-BY-NC-4.0](reasonir/LICENSE) |

Diver attribution belongs to its upstream contributors. ReasonIR attribution belongs to its upstream contributors, including the copyright notices retained in each source file. ReasonIR's noncommercial license applies to these reference copies; a license on newly authored project files does not replace either upstream license.

Selected files were retrieved through the GitHub connector on 2026-11-04. Original source bytes, including final-newline behavior, are preserved. [The provenance manifest](../../provenance/sources.json) records each source URL, upstream commit, Git blob SHA, SHA-256, byte count, and equality check. No snapshot was imported or executed during collection.

The Diver requirements file is a historical reference, not this project's environment specification. Data-generation examples may contain API calls; their inclusion is not authorization to run them or transmit any data. No datasets or model weights are included.

The missing RICE-PO author repository and unresolved paper-to-implementation choices are recorded in the provenance manifest. These dependency snapshots cannot resolve those gaps by themselves.
